title: Decompose provider initialization and parallelize Terraform plan jobs
creator: Lian Chen
description:
Problem: Several terraform workspaces experience very long plan times (>20m) and frequent unrelated diffs after provider pinning or perf tweaks. Root causes identified: (1) implicit provider inheritance across deep module graphs forces Terraform to reinitialize multiple duplicate provider instances and re-evaluate resource meta-arguments, (2) provider plugin downloads and legacy provider_installation config in CI add wall-clock time, and (3) coarse module boundaries make small networking changes cascade into many workspace plans.

Proposal: refactor how providers are declared and passed to modules, introduce a small dedicated providers module per cloud account/region that centralizes aliases and version pins, and change modules to accept explicit providers rather than relying on implicit inheritance. Update CI runner and developer CLI config to use a shared provider mirror and pre-installed plugins, enable parallelism flags and targeted plan steps, and break network templates into thinner overlays so changes hit fewer modules. As part of the rollout, upgrade provider versions to tested releases (aws 5.x, azurerm 4.x, google 5.x - see upgrade matrix link) and provide a migration playbook with a staged rollout plan for staging -> canary -> prod workspaces.
acceptance_criteria: Full terraform plan time for the largest workspace reduced by >=40% in CI (baseline: 22m)
CI plan latency for incremental network changes < 8 minutes for targeted runs
All refactored modules accept explicit provider parameters and no implicit provider references remain in infra/modules/*
Provider plugin downloads removed from CI by using preinstalled mirror; CI variance reduced (median <30s extra)
Provider version upgrade applied to staging and validated without drift for 7 days before prod rollout
Runbooks and a migration checklist (Confluence) created and linked in ticket
tasks: Create providers-module template that exposes region/account aliases and pins (infra/modules/providers)
Refactor 3 largest networking modules to accept provider objects and remove implicit provider usage
Add provider-installation mirror config to CI runners and validate plugin cache behavior
Add targeted plan scripts (./scripts/plan-target.sh) that use -target or run partial applies for incremental work
Performance benchmark: add synthetic plan job in CI that measures wall time before/after changes
Prepare migration playbook with rollback commands and PR checklist for each workspace
